diagnosis: Check C3 passed in all rollouts despite the decision-maker lacking access to PF1. The leak occurs because the model defaults to a safety-first heuristic, setting 'palletizer_operating_during_repair' to false, which satisfies C3 without needing the specific information about the cracked bearing.

C3.why: The cracked bearing changes the repair plan to a Saturday 06:00 start, an exact 6-hour outage, and a prohibition on operating P-7 during the repair.

fix_instructions: Tighten check C3 by requiring the model to explicitly state the prohibition of operating P-7 as a direct consequence of the cracked bearing (PF1), rather than allowing it to pass via a generic safety default. Additionally, ensure C3 requires the exact 6-hour outage duration or the specific Saturday 06:00 start time to prevent passing through general weekend maintenance assumptions.
